summary: Examples of to_json for a compact document and a prettier one with indent=4 and sort_keys=True (like to_nice_json).
questions: How do I pretty print JSON with to_json?

answer_card.title: to_json examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
{{ docker_config | to_json }}
{{ docker_config | to_json(indent=4, sort_keys=True) }}   # like to_nice_json
```
